description:
FOUND s455c by sb-sprof on the pack bench loop (see #74 update): p-find-overload 8.0% self / 14.3% total, p-get-class 3.2/6.3, %p-target-class 3.2 -- on operands that are plain strings/fixnums in boxes, where the answer is always NO overload.  Since #119/#402 made more op families overload-aware, every such op pays this lookup.  FIX SHAPE: the earliest possible rejection -- an operand that is not a p-box holding a blessed value (or is a raw number/string) cannot carry overloads; one type test before any class walk, and consider caching per-CLASS overload presence (a class with NO overload table answers once).  BAR: sb-sprof before/after on the pack loop (expect ~15-20% off) + bench rows arrhash/ovlsub/pack + the overload guard files (Pl/t/overload-01.t) + full sweep (cl/ change).  Broad Target-A item: benefits every boxed-op-dense program, not pack alone.  Round-14 perf slot candidate beside #77/#811.

DONE s458ak.  ONE inline predicate %p-no-overload-possible-p answers "this operand provably carries no overload" with, in order, (1) a struct-slot read of (hash-table-count *p-overload-table*) -- p-register-overloads is the table's only writer, so an empty table means no `use overload` anywhere in the image -- and (2) the PLAIN-PAYLOAD test (number/string/nil/undef), for which p-get-class provably answers NIL: %p-target-class rejects those four by name and %p-ref-shaped-p (the guard on the box's own class slot) is false for all four, so even a box carrying a stale class cannot report one.  The predicate guards p-find-overload itself AND, inline at the call site, the four hot askers: %with-binary-overload, %def-overloaded-cmp's four lookups, %def-overloaded-str-cmp's four, box-nv's "0+", box-sv's '""', and %p-true-p-slow's "bool".  Inlining at the CALL SITE is what mattered: guarding only p-find-overload bought 3.4 % on pack because the CALL itself remained.  MEASURED: pack 4.5148 s -> 4.3867 s; ovlsub 3.81x -> 3.49x; the biggest single effect is on any boxed-scalar loop (see #811's escaping-reference accumulator, 0.2521 -> 0.1734 s, which is #811+#815 together).  Bar met: gate 190/6373, full sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18340 (+0), overload-01.t green.
subject: p-find-overload + p-get-class/%p-target-class = ~20% of a plain-data hot loop (the pack oracle) -- the overload NEGATIVE path needs a one-check early exit for unblessed operands
